summary: Link-local IPv6 addresses need a zone identifier (such as an interface name) to say which network link they belong to. This document explains how users should type that identifier into user interfaces such as address fields. It replaces RFC 6874 and updates RFC 4007, RFC 7622 and RFC 8089.

eli5.summary: Some house numbers repeat on every street, so you must also say which street you mean. This tells software how people should write that extra street name next to an address.
